This section serves as a repository for artefacts that provide evidence of my learning and professional development throughout the Biostatistical Consulting & Collaboration module and internship.

## Confidentiality Note

::: {.callout-important}
## Confidentiality and Data Protection

All artefacts included in this portfolio comply with confidentiality agreements and data protection requirements. Sensitive information has been anonymized or excluded where necessary.

- Client data is protected
- Proprietary methods and code are excluded
- Personal identifying information is removed
- All materials are used with appropriate permissions
:::
